- Tue Apr 30, 1600–1800
- Wed May 1, 1800–2000 (we can do later evenings if needed)
- Thu May 2, 0900–1100 (mornings work for our SOC ops)

Can you confirm Redwood’s availability and whether you can provide an on-call backup for the meeting in case of runbook/questions after the call?

Thanks,

- Day 2: 30-min vendor briefing (PentestCo orientation + rules of engagement)

- Tue Apr 30: 1600–1730 (Rishi available; Jasmine can extend to 1800 if needed)
- Wed May 1: 1830–2000 (evening slot — Jasmine only available after 1830)
- Thu May 2: 0900–1030 (both available)

2) Can you mark whether you want the vendor to do a live demo or orientation-only before May 6 (per your change freeze)?

I’ll tentatively hold Tue Apr 30 1600–1730 until you confirm.
